text: Sometimes one number matters more than any comparison. Here's how to show it well — and let viewers filter it themselves.
A card puts one measure front and center. Add more than one value, and more cards appear automatically.

A bare number rarely tells the whole story, though. Reference labels pair the headline with supporting detail — Revenue variance and its percentage, right alongside the main figure. A KPI visual goes one step further still: instead of just a value, it shows progress toward an actual target.

Slicers put filtering right on the canvas — always visible, unlike the Filters pane. And here's a subtlety worth knowing: select all, then clear one value, and the slicer applies an is-not filter for just that one value — not an is filter listing everything else. New data added later gets included automatically, since nothing explicitly excluded it.
